eyebrow.zh: 装前看清 · 更新防变宽 · 流水线兜底
eyebrow.en: See before install · Catch the creep · Pipeline fails it

headline.zh:
你信的 Skill 悄悄加了危险权限
流水线先替你拦下来
headline.en:
A skill you trust quietly widens its reach
your pipeline catches it before you do

sub.zh: 给团队里每一个 Claude Code Skill 配一道闸：装之前看清它能碰你的哪些文件、网络、命令；更新后一旦它想多拿一点权限，流水线直接挂掉，而不是事后才让你发现。
sub.en: Give every Claude Code skill in your team a gate: see which of your files, network, and shell it can touch before you install; and the moment a new version reaches for more than you signed off, the pipeline fails — not you, after the fact.

title.zh: 一份清单，写清它能碰什么
title.en: One list: exactly what it can touch

body.zh: 每个 Skill 配一份声明清单，白纸黑字写明它可以读写的文件、能不能联网、能跑哪些命令、面向哪个模型；装之前一屏看完，不用通读整份 prompt 才知道它到底会干什么。
body.en: Each skill carries a declared list — plainly stating which files it can read and write, whether it goes online, which commands it can run, and which model it targets; you see it on one screen before installing, no need to read the whole prompt to know what it will actually do.

chips: › 文件 · 网络 · 命令 · 模型

title.zh: 更新后偷偷加权限，当场抓到
title.en: A sneaky permission bump, caught on update

body.zh: 上周你审过、信过的那个 Skill，今天一个新版本把删文件、读密钥、外联网络的权限悄悄塞了进来——不用你逐行比对，它会被直接标红，流水线当场挂掉。
body.en: The skill you reviewed and trusted last week ships a new version that quietly slips in delete-files, read-your-keys, or phone-home permission — no line-by-line diffing needed, it is flagged red and the pipeline fails on the spot.

title.zh: 跑的这份，真是你审过的那份吗
title.en: Is the one running the one you reviewed?

body.zh: 签名替你回答一个问题：上周过目、点头放行的那个 Skill，和今天机器上拉下来的那个，是不是一字不差的同一份。不是，就别跑。
body.en: A signature answers one question: is the skill you eyeballed and approved last week the exact one that just landed on your machine, byte for byte. If not, do not run it.

title.zh: 一个能挡住流水线的红绿灯
title.en: A traffic light your pipeline can block on

body.zh: 每个 Skill 最后落到一个明确判定：放行、没签名、还是越权变宽。只要有没签名或越权的，流水线直接挂掉——全程在你本机跑完，不联网、不依赖外部服务。
body.en: Every skill ends in a clear verdict: trusted, unsigned, or scope-widened. One unsigned or widened skill and the pipeline fails outright — all on your own machine, no network, no external service.

chips: › 放行 / 没签名 / 越权

headline.zh: 给团队装的 Skill，配一道闸
headline.en: Put a gate on your team's skills

sub.zh: MIT 许可，一条命令装好：看清每个 Skill 能碰什么，更新后自动拦住偷偷变宽的权限。
sub.en: MIT-licensed, one command to install: see what each skill can touch, and auto-block any sneaky scope creep on update.
